about: SYSTEM S7. Stable ids for meaningful UI states. 'extension' marks ids beyond the S7 text examples (J0-J8, T0-T1); owner may rename. Predicates are over JourneyViewModel.State / TimetableViewModel.ScreenState; classifier = ScreenStateCatalogue (test tree).

journey.name: empty
journey.predicate: info valid, no endpoints, no candidates, no result

journey.name: destination chosen only (extension to S7 text)
both stations, platforms not narrowed
journey.predicate: both chosen; at least one selection has >1 platform

journey.name: platforms chosen
journey.predicate: both chosen and each narrowed to exactly one platform; no result

journey.name: street-map preview open
journey.predicate: map-side: WalkingMapPreviewSession.isOpen(); not observable from JourneyViewModel

journey.name: street-map preview expired, return kept
journey.predicate: map-side: preview line gone after 5 min, return token kept (owner decision 10-28 option b)

journey.name: returned from map
journey.predicate: message == journey_return_replan, endpoints restored, result == null

journey.name: departed (extension)
journey.predicate: message == journey_departed, endpoints kept, result == null

journey.name: retired with changed/reselect message (extension)
journey.predicate: info == null and message in {journey_changed, journey_return_reselect}

journey.name: busy overlay (extension)
journey.predicate: busy == true; overlays any other state

timetable.name: board
timetable.predicate: READY with selectedStop != null and board non-empty

timetable.name: candidates
timetable.predicate: READY with selectedStop == null and candidates non-empty

timetable.name: pack ready, nothing chosen (extension)
timetable.predicate: READY/IDLE, packPresent, no selection, no candidates

timetable.name: no results (extension)
timetable.predicate: status NO_RESULTS (empty search, or selected stop with empty board)
